1 صَعِدَ فِى السُّلَّمِ , (S, A, Msb, K,) aor.
صَعَدَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. صُعُودٌ (S, Msb, K) and صَعَدٌ and صُعُدٌ; (Ham p. 407;) and ↓ تصعّد , (A,) or اِصَّعَّدَ, (L,) inf. n. اِصَّعُّدٌ; (K;) and ↓ تصاعد , (A,) or اِصَّاعَدَ, (L,) inf. n. اِصَّاعُدٌ; (K;) and ↓ اصطعد ; (K;) He ascended, or went up, the ladder, or stair: (L, Msb, K:) and so the verb is used of ascending a thing similar to a ladder, or stair: but in a case of this kind one should not say اصعد. (L.) And صَعِدَ السَّطْحَ and إِلَى السَّطْحِ (A, Msb) He ascended, or ascended to, the flat house-top. (Msb.) And صَعِدَ المَكَانَ, and فِى المَكَانِ, and ↓ اصعد , and ↓ صعّد , He ascended the place, or upon the place. (L.) And فِى ↓ صعّد الجَبَلِ, (S, A, Msb, K,) and عَلَى الجَبَلِ, inf. n. تَصْعِيدٌ; (S, K;) and صَعِدَ فِيهِ, a form rarely used, (Msb,) disallowed by AZ, (S, TA,) and said by him to have been unknown, (S,) or unheard, (K,) but he afterwards authorized it, and it is also authorized by IAar and ISk, (TA,) and صَعِدَ الجَبَلَ; (S in art. دخل; [for صَعِدَ فِى الجَبَلِ, see دَخَلْتُ البَيْتَ;]) and فِيهِ ↓ تصعّد , (MF, from a trad.,) and اِصَّعَّدَ فِيهِ, (AZ,) inf. n. اِصِّعَّادٌ; (TA; [app. a mistranscription for اِصَّعُّدٌ; or اِصَّعَّدَ may be a mistranscription for ↓ اِصَّعَدَ , a var. of اِصْطَعَدَ, and its inf. n. is اِصِّعَادٌ;]) He ascended the mountain. (Msb, K.) And فِى الأَرْضِ ↓ صعّد He ascended the land. (AZ, TA.) One says, طَالَ ↓ فِى الأَرْضِ تَصْوِيبِى وَتَصْعِيدِى [Long have continued my descending, or going down, and my ascending, or going up, in the land]. (A. [There immediately following صَعَّدَ فِى الجَبَلِ, expl. above: see also رَكَبٌ مُصَعِّدٌ.]) ＝
-A2- See also 4, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
